context: Write a signed-off decision record and update tracker state so exactly one pre-created path TODO becomes actionable. Both path TODOs start blocked. On SHADOW_ONLY, keep both blocked or drop them with reasons and retain full strict CI. On REDUCED_FAST_REFRESH, unblock only strict-base-refresh-07a-reduced-fast-refresh-rollout. On NATIVE_MERGE_QUEUE, unblock only strict-base-refresh-07b-native-merge-queue-migration. Never implement both.
description: Act as the final no-activation-by-default gate. Consume the live policy record, shadow classifier evidence, historical replay, full-CI profile, and native merge-queue assessment. Select exactly one outcome: SHADOW_ONLY, REDUCED_FAST_REFRESH, or NATIVE_MERGE_QUEUE. A reduced path must name the exact lanes it may waive and explicitly accept residual runtime-integration risk. A queue path must have an operator-approved transfer and complete merge_group plan. The privileged steward remains out of scope.

anti_patterns.dont: Approve activation because shadow invariants matched full lint
anti_patterns.instead: use full-only failure replay and explicit residual-risk acceptance
anti_patterns.why: that does not prove skipped test safety

anti_patterns.dont: Select reduced refresh without naming every waived lane
anti_patterns.instead: bind an explicit typed waiver contract
anti_patterns.why: generic skipped status can hide missing or cancelled checks
parallel merge authorities violate the consolidated policy

anti_patterns.dont: Use an arbitrary day or sample count as the sole gate
anti_patterns.instead: require all negative controls, reason coverage, and eligible-yield evidence
anti_patterns.why: coverage and counterexamples matter more than elapsed time

preserves.behavior: A SHADOW_ONLY result is a valid completion and does not require engineering a fast path
Exactly one implementation authority can be actionable
